Name: Harvey's Clinic Expanded
Author: blueOstrich
Description:
This mod adds new drinks to Harvey's Clinic. There are ten new drinks, and each give a +2 of one buff, lasts 3 minutes, and cost 500 gold. I felt that the drink selection and Harvey's Clinic were both lacking a little, so this is my fix for that. 

[u]New drinks: [/u]
Farming Tonic: + 2 farming buff
Fishing Tonic: +2 fishing buff
Foraging Tonic: + 2 foraging buff
Attack Tonic: + 2 attack buff
Speed Tonic: + 2 speed buff
Max Energy Tonic: + 2 max energy buff
Defense Tonic: + 2 defense buff
Speed Tonic: + 2 speed buff
Mining Tonic: + 2 mining buff
Magnetism Tonic: + 2 magnetism buff
